name: Capsakid
description: Capsakid, the Spicy Pepper Pokémon. Able to evolve into Scovillain. A Grass type.
pokedex_entries: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.
Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.
